_comment: Coordinator-only template. First run `node p3-role-packet.mjs --expand-ustar <plain-ustar.tar> <new-inspection-directory>`; it accepts only plain USTAR and rejects traversal, links, special/PAX/GNU entries, archives nested as attachments, and role-input exclusions. Then replace every REPLACE value and remove this _comment before `--check`. packetRoot is that newly expanded real directory; archive attachments are rejected by the validator. The validator also rejects `.git`, MyBrain/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, STATE.md, P3-CONTRACT-RECORDS.md, P-3 contract/J/evidence/evaluator records, .figma-gate, P-3 ledger/pair locks, and any actual-worktree overlap. identityAuthority must reference the actual v13 condition contract and owner-approved Decision J v2 outside packetRoot; version 12 and every earlier contract are rejected without migration.
